地図上での音声・手書き入力をAIがリアルタイムで処理し、地域の歴史・地理・防災など幅広い学習場面での活用を支援します。

sourceLinesEn: We’re excited to announce our breakthrough 25 Degree of Freedom (DOF), tendon-driven hands for the NEO humanoid platform– achieving near human-level dexterity, strength, safety, and reliability.
These hands are designed to do something fundamental: remove the hardware ceiling on what humanoid robots can actually do, and make data the only barrier to capabilities.
By matching or surpassing human hands across the dimensions that matter, they ensure our AI models are no longer limited by dexterity.
